steps.why: The interpreter and the two modules built for it.

steps.script: test "$(lua -e 'local lpeg, uv = require("lpeg"), require("luv"); assert(uv.now() >= 0); print(lpeg.match(lpeg.R("09")^1, "42") * 14)')" = 42

steps.why: utf8proc composes, folds case, measures a wide character and names a category.

steps.script: printf '%s\n' '#include <stdlib.h>' '#include <string.h>' '#include <utf8proc.h>' 'int main(void) {' '  unsigned char *composed = utf8proc_NFC((const unsigned char *)"e\xcc\x81");' '  unsigned char *folded = utf8proc_NFKC_Casefold((const unsigned char *)"DOLLY");' '  int ok = composed && !strcmp((char *)composed, "\xc3\xa9") && folded && !strcmp((char *)folded, "dolly") &&' '      utf8proc_charwidth(0x65e5) == 2 && utf8proc_category(0x41) == UTF8PROC_CATEGORY_LU;' '  free(composed);' '  free(folded);' '  return ok ? 0 : 1;' '}' > /tmp/amy-utf8proc.c && cc /tmp/amy-utf8proc.c -lutf8proc -o /tmp/amy-utf8proc && /tmp/amy-utf8proc

steps.why: The tree-sitter runtime makes a parser, which parses nothing without a grammar.

steps.script: printf '%s\n' '#include <tree_sitter/api.h>' 'int main(void) {' '  TSParser *parser = ts_parser_new();' '  if (!parser || ts_parser_language(parser)) return 1;' '  int ok = !ts_parser_parse_string(parser, NULL, "x", 1) && TREE_SITTER_LANGUAGE_VERSION >= 14;' '  ts_parser_delete(parser);' '  return ok ? 0 : 1;' '}' > /tmp/amy-tree-sitter.c && cc /tmp/amy-tree-sitter.c -ltree-sitter -o /tmp/amy-tree-sitter && /tmp/amy-tree-sitter
